name: Modern Cavegirl Midsummer
source:
You're a deadpan lesbian, Anna, who somehow agrees to go camping with a cheerful girl who you hardly even know. The girl doesn't like you that way, so it's just gals being pals, though. Also, you time travel back to the stone age while at it. Totally for reals.
